name: 5 Ways Men Ruin Relationships Without Realizing It

lines.ref:
5 Ways Men Ruin Relationships
Without Realizing It

1. By shutting down instead
of speaking up

2. By stopping the small acts
of affection

4. By treating her consistency
as something guaranteed

5. By acting "tired" every time she
needs emotional connection

shots.brief: couple sitting together outdoors talking and smiling (ref: Young couple sitting on a stone wall by a marina, smiling and conversing warmly; tripod)
person sitting alone looking pensively out a window (ref: Young man sitting back in an armchair next to a window, looking pensively outside; filmed by friend)
partner walking away and turning back to wave (ref: Young woman turning around to wave goodbye at night outside a building; POV)
couple hanging out casually at an outdoor venue (ref: Woman sitting at an outdoor bar counter while man behind her flashes a peace sign; selfie)
couple leaning against a railing with city skyline in background (ref: Couple taking a photo together on the Brooklyn Bridge with the city skyline behind them; tripod)
person browsing an art installation or illuminated wall display (ref: Young woman standing in an illuminated room admiring notes hanging on a fairy-lit wall; filmed by friend)

audit.notes: To recreate this exact relationship prompt, clips of a couple are required. However, the exact numbered list format ('X Ways People Ruin Y Without Realizing It') seamlessly adapts to solo lifestyle b-roll by changing the topic to career, fitness, mental health, or personal productivity.
audit.summary: A 6-shot montage of couple moments and reflective solo shots paired with text overlay listing 5 subtle relationship mistakes men make.
